d: Jharkhand ke jamshedpur se hokar guzarne vali svarnarekha nadi ke kinare sthaniy gramin varshon se nadi ki mitti aur balu se paranprik tarikon se sone ke sunahre kan nikalne ka kathin kam karte aa rahe hain. kaee ganvon ke graminon ka yah sangharsh bahut adhik sharirik pira aur anishchit aamadni ke bich varshon se jari hai.
